title: Crispy Rice Leaves Rolls
description: A Chinese-inspired snack made with crispy rice leaves and various ingredients. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Cut the crispy rice leaves into long strips.
In a bowl, mix together the fatty, turkish, and stuffed ingredients.
Add the chopped leaves to the bowl and mix well.
Place a tablespoon of the mixture onto a crispy rice leaf strip, leaving a small border around the edges.
Roll up the leaf tightly and secure with a toothpick, if needed.
Place the rolls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the rolls are crispy and golden brown.
